I'm Mrinal Sharan (MorningStar online). I build ML systems and study how to make
machine-learned models of physics faster and more reliable.

**Now.** I'm CTO and co-founder of Coffee AI, which builds B2B AI tools for UK
trades contractors. I'm also an incoming DPhil student at the University of
Oxford in the Intelligent Earth Centre
for Doctoral Training, working on AI/ML.

**Research background.** I did my Master's at Oxford and finished top of my
cohort. My thesis was on machine-learned interatomic potentials for halide
perovskites, specifically fine-tuning [MACE](https://github.com/ACEsuit/mace)
foundation models to get close to DFT accuracy at a small fraction of the cost.

**Interests.** Equivariant graph neural networks, ML inference infrastructure,
and GPU kernels: in short, the path from a model on paper to a model that runs
fast on real hardware.

**This site.** [Notes](notes/index.qmd) holds technical writing: deep dives,
paper reproductions and kernels. The [Journal](journal/index.qmd) is a shorter,
informal log of building Coffee AI.

## Publications and open source

- *Master's thesis*: MACE fine-tuning for halide perovskites (2025).
